newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Blue chips drive Mauritius bourse index down.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips drive Mauritius bourse index down.

text.p: The Mauritius Stock Exchange share index Semdex fell 1.82 points on Monday to 374.49 on blue chip weakness and lack of liquidity, brokers said.
Turnover rose to 10.84 million rupees on 179,128 shares from 3.71 million rupees on 132,543 shares last Friday.

Brokers said they expected subdued market sentiment after a heavy absorption of funds through subscriptions of secured debentures such as Gamma Civic, Happy World Foods, Rogers, Sun Resorts and Mauritius Port Louis Fund.
"I have the impression that the stock market is influenced by the central bank as investors and fund managers are having a close look at the weekly treasury bills auction," one broker said.

Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) lost 50 cents to 87.50 rupees on 100,698 shares, accounting for about 80 percent of total transactions. State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) eased 30 cents to 12.30 rupees on 19,945 shares.

Sun Resorts fell 20 cents to 47.70 rupees on 30 shares, Grand Baie Hotel (GBH) was 50 cents down to 52.00 rupees, but was not quoted and New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) was stable at 38.00 rupees on 5,510 shares.
Commerce conglomerates Rogers lost 50 cents to 90.50 rupees on 6,133 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd (IBL) was unchanged to 15.40 rupees on 650 shares.
Sugar based Mon Tresor Mon Desert (MTMD) was stable at 38.10 rupees on 2,018 shares. Air Mauritius was unchanged to 35.40 rupees on 2,404 shares.
